'''Roab''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]], [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], and [[Rakghoul serum|rakghoul vaccines]] aboard [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roab first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a stimulant vendor aboard Carrick Station.<ref name="TOR" />
